title: Professional Certificate in Selecting a Research Topic
description: The Professional Certificate in Developing Research Question aims to equip the learner with a detailed understanding of the nature and importance of a research question.
longDescription: What is research and its purposes? Introduction to choosing a research topic. Factors to consider when choosing a research topic. Critical methods used for choosing a research topic and good research topics. Selecting a topic. Research question, its types and its features. Understanding research aims. Changing research questions into aims. Three traps for the unwary. The Professional Certificate in Developing Research Question aims to equip the learner with a detailed understanding of the nature and importance of research questions and introduces the learner to techniques to develop a professional research question.
